author: National Geographic
description:
In this National Geographic MEGA Episode Special compilation, dive into the mysteries beneath our ocean waves in three popular series: OceanXplorers, Drain the Oceans, and Titanic: The Digital Resurrection. In the first episode, the OceanXplorers team travels to the Azores to study the sixgill shark. Next, the Drain the Oceans team examines emerging evidence about the lost city of Atlantis. Finally, learn about a cutting-edge project that has provided new information about the infamous sinking ship in the Northern Atlantic Ocean in 1912. 

OceanXplorers - Jurassic Shark
The team is in the Azores to tag a mysterious deep-sea giant rarely encountered by humans, the sixgill shark, and learn more about its nightly patterns on the hunt for food in the abyss as an apex predator. For the first time ever, the team tags this deep sea monster and retrieves valuable data, uncovering the secrets of why this prehistoric shark undertakes its epic journey from the depths at night.
